description.value: Juan de Fuca Recreation Centre is a publicly operated civic sports and recreation facility run by Westshore Parks and Recreation in the Westshore area near Victoria. It serves the broader Capital Regional District community and is typical of large multi-purpose Canadian recreation centres that anchor neighbourhood activity. Touring cyclists in the Victoria area may find it a useful stop given its public mandate and likely range of facilities.
